text:
The covenant is likely enforceable because continued employment for a meaningful period can constitute sufficient consideration for a restrictive covenant signed after hire, especially where the employer was not obligated to retain her. However, enforceability also depends on whether the covenant is reasonable in scope, duration, and geographic reach, and a two-year post-termination period may be scrutinized. The employer therefore has a legal basis to seek enforcement, but success is not guaranteed.
